technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with strong short-term bullish technicals (RSI, SAR, SuperTrend, Hull) but overbought oscillators and bearish intermediate structure (below 50/200 MAs, below cloud) create conflicting signals; moderate confluence with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 35 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal with mixed small trades 140+ days old; broad market fear (42/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory news data and recent insider conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (407), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 35 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum technicals (RSI, SAR, SuperTrend, Hull, OBV) are aligned bullish with price near support (106.31), offering a tactical bounce setup in a fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, price below all major moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), below Ichimoku cloud, macro crisis (VIX 407, flat yield curve, strong dollar), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings risk in 35 days create a high-probability reversal trap.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term technicals (RSI, SAR, SuperTrend) show bullish alignment at support, and broad market fear presents contrarian opportunity. However, macro crisis, overbought oscillators, price below all major MAs, and earnings risk in 35 days create unacceptable risk/reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (407), flat yield curve recession signal, and earnings event in 35 days create high probability of sharp reversal that invalidates short-term momentum setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical bullish signals overwhelmed by fundamental weakness, macro crisis, and risk concentration
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 15 existing Industrials positions (33% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip to preserve capital in crisis environment.
